raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-KHM-BasicEducationImprovement",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "School mentoring funding disbursed directly to primary school clusters may not be properly monitored, risking misallocation or improper reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop and adopt simplified guidelines for school mentoring funding within the Project Operations Manual and conduct internal audit oversight.",
      "evidence": "There is a risk that school mentoring funding, which is to be spent at the schools, may not be properly monitored."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Workload overload among FM staff at the Directorate General of Administration and Finance could delay transaction processing and financial reporting.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint adequate financial management staff, including government officers and consultants, within three months of project signing.",
      "evidence": "The current FM staff at the Directorate General of Administration and Finance may be overloaded, potentially leading to delays in processing transactions and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Delays in approving the Annual Work Plan and Budget (AWPB) could impede the timely execution of planned project activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a simplified AWPB template and standardized approval timeline in the Financial Management Manual.",
      "evidence": "The delayed approval of the Annual Work Plan and Budget (AWPB) may hinder the timely implementation of project activities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Limited staff knowledge and experience with World Bank Procurement Regulations could result in procurement noncompliance and schedule slippage.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Assign full-time procurement officers to the project and deliver targeted procurement and contract management training.",
      "evidence": "MoEYS staff’s limited knowledge and experience with the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations, potentially resulting in project implementation delays and noncompliance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delays in receiving technical inputs and obtaining internal clearance from the procurement review committee may disrupt procurement processing timelines.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish explicit service standards in the POM, track procurement inputs via STEP, and delegate review authority to committee members.",
      "evidence": "possible delays in receiving technical inputs for procurement; ... possible delays in internal clearance from procurement review committee."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Governance and corruption risks during procurement transactions could undermine project resource allocation and fairness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce enhanced disclosure of procurement information, publish contract awards quarterly, and implement a robust complaint handling mechanism.",
      "evidence": "governance risks, including corrupt practices in procurement;"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management may lead to poor vendor performance and delivery delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted contract management training to the procurement team and designate technical department focal points for cross-departmental coordination.",
      "evidence": "inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management, which may result in implementation delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Climate change hazards such as severe flooding, tropical cyclones, and extreme heat threaten school infrastructure damage and educational continuity.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct classrooms and childcare centers using climate-resilient, elevated designs, solar panels, and expand e-learning platforms for emergency instruction.",
      "evidence": "Natural disasters caused by climate change, including floods, cyclones, and extreme heat, pose significant challenges for Cambodia, particularly affecting the continuity of education."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Scaling up Early Grade Learning (EGL) and targeted instruction nationally through government systems may encounter capability constraints that reduce program fidelity.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement an implementation science-informed learning agenda utilizing rapid testing, process evaluations, and adaptive adjustments.",
      "evidence": "Transitioning from successful, donor-funded interventions with limited geographic coverage to implementation at scale through government systems requires overcoming the many technical, financial, political economy, and capability constraints"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "The Early Learning Partnership Trust Fund closing date in April 2027 precedes the project closing date in 2030, risking premature interruption of childcare grant funding.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Front-load trust fund disbursements for Subcomponent 1.1 and integrate childcare training into the National Preschool Teacher Training Center prior to 2027.",
      "evidence": "The closing date for the Trust Fund differs from that of the project. The Trust Fund is scheduled to close on April 30, 2027."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "The phase-out of key development partner assistance by 2027 may cause monitoring and evaluation gaps and financial sustainability challenges for EGL programs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Build ministry M&E capacity, digitize progress tracking, and institutionalize cluster-based mentoring funding within regular government operations.",
      "evidence": "Their support is expected to phase out by 2027. Due to these one-off interventions, there are gaps in M&E for building the ministry’s capacity to sustain programs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "HRMIS modernization progression to Phase 2 depends on Phase 1 proving technical quality and regulatory feasibility; delays or failure in Phase 1 could stall rollout.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a formal joint working group with the Ministry of Civil Service to align system scoping and functional mapping during Phase 1.",
      "evidence": "Progression to Phase 2 is conditional on Phase 1 results demonstrating quality and feasibility in terms of technical and system development"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Small, dispersed procurement packages for community school buildings may fail to attract competitive bidders or lead to inconsistent construction quality across subnational areas.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize structured open national and subnational procurement approaches, group adjacent works where viable, and enforce standardized supervision guidelines.",
      "evidence": "These packages would not be attractive to the international market and will therefore be procured through open national and subnational approaches"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Civil works for classroom, preschool, and childcare construction pose potential environmental and social risks (e.g., land acquisition, impacts on indigenous peoples).",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply the Environmental and Social Management Framework, conduct land and indigenous peoples screening, and implement universal accessibility design standards.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social Risk Classification: Substantial"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Prevalence of Gender-Based Violence (GBV) and risk of SEA/SH during infrastructure expansion and school activities could harm vulnerable students and community members.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deliver teacher training on GBV awareness, implement a GBV prevention action plan, and operationalize a dedicated SEA/SH grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Tackling GBV remains a paramount concern in Cambodia... significant lack of comprehensive data on GBV prevalence, overall, in the education sector"
    }
  ]
}
